HoldFolderC.dc.html.title: C · Hold on a folder tile

row1.text: Cover grid: a folder tile, a book not on the device, pages by rows

row2.text: Hold opens the menu for what you held

row3.text: Series and Authors replace the placeholders

scale.text: Every board is the Kindle Colorsoft at half size (1264×1680 on the device). C is Diner, the default look; A is Editorial. Covers are typographic placeholders; the device draws real covers.

grid.text: Decided (owner, 2026-10-16): sub-folders show as a tile in the grid; progress strip sits under the cover; the grid is always 3 columns, no density setting; the not-downloaded badge stays as the design target and is built with the grid, though nothing shows it until a remote source exists. Still to settle when cover-grid is specified: sort and status are remembered per folder; the grid pages by swipe, the pager is also tappable.

hold.text: Delete asks to confirm, then goes through KOReader's own delete so sidecars and history follow. "Add to the home" pins the book as the featured book.

lists.text: Decided (owner, 2026-10-16): authors sort by surname (last word, prefixes like Le and de kept with it) under letter dividers; a book with two authors appears under both and counts for both. The series list puts series under way first, then the rest A to Z; one series lists in series order with the next unread marked. Series is not a nav tab, so no tab is lit there.
